book.name: APALYNAH
book.title: APALYNAH JOHAN TEI A HMUHPAW APALYNAH BIA

content: Ma khy taico a ka huichy neh ka, vaicung letei ingkaw a hongpaw cawh ka hmuh. Taico, o ka thui taw caipaw hmoka hratei a cangpaw taco bia pa ching ka, “Ma lang heh ka kechy tua, ato tai hei hming a ung lepaw sahlo cawh ka ca hmuh sá a,” a pa tah.
Sung sungkheh tah Thlawpaw tah va ung neh ka, taico vaicung letaco abui dyching sangkheh cawh hmuh neh ka, ma buidyching cung letaco pakheh a va ty.
A va typaw cawh alung ahringpaw jaspar le asaipaw carnilian hmuisang lo ka, taico abui dyching cawh emerald alung hmuisang ky a lopaw mesakupaw tah a cadung.
Taico, abui dyching kaekang letaco ahringpaw abui dyching sangki sangpali ung ka, a cung letaco macang paki le papali a ty he. Aa zongmingtei tah pai rangpaw a buh he ka, suilukhu a khu he.
Mataico, abui dyching taico lailaw le o le khalung py sahlo cawh va ring caimang ka, abui dyching hme letaco me-ing sangsarih cawh ae ka, ma sahlo cawh Khazing thlawpaw sangsarih khah a cang he.

Taico, abui dyching hme leco thlalang hratah a cangpaw rili, kristal alung hratei a pasingpaw cawh ung ka, abui dyching letah le abui dyching kaekang letaco hminghring sangpali, aa hning le hme tei mehkho tei a chih thlangpaw cawh a ung he.

Hminghring sangkhehnah cawh cakebarung hratah cang ka, a sanghningnah cawh co tungnypaw hratah a cang, a sangthungnah cawh cawngsaw hme hapaw hme pho ka, a sangpalinah cawh pahmupui a zy leimeining teipaw hratah a cang.
Ma hminghring sangpalipaw cawh mathlaw sangruh cacy aa hnui, aa pungpaluh cawh mehkho tah aa mathlaw rai tai zong a chih. Mataico,

content.text: a ung ciapaw le a ung leimeipaw le a ung lepaw cawh,
a pathai, a pathai, a pathai,”

content: tatah ching le zai a hia lytah aa tah.
Ma hminghring sangpali sahlo taco, abui dyching letei a typaw, chaizaw tei a hring paria thlangpaw cawh aa parungnawsah, aa upah, lunglawngnah bia zong aa hlai.
Ma hratei aa tuaning maikaw tah macang paki le papali sahlo taco, abui dyching letei a typaw a hme letaco aa khuh panai he ka, chaizaw tah chaizaw tai a hringpaw cawh aa beh.

content.text: “Nama, kaa Buipaw le kaa Khazing cawh rungnawnah le
pasungpanawnah le hmingtuakhynah vytei cawh a hnui tlangpaw na cang.
Zemaw tah pawco nama tah zezong vytei tua ceh ka,
na dupaw hratah a va chuhpaw a cang he,” tah he ka,
aa builukhu zong cawh abui dyching hme letaco aa chia.
